import re

# Solution.py
def count_words(text):
    # Split the text into words based on whitespace
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    
    # Count the occurrences of each word
    word_counts = {}
    for word in words:
        if word in word_counts:
            word_counts[word] += 1
        else:
            word_counts[word] = 1
    
    return word_counts

# Test cases
print(count_words("Hello world! Hello Python"))
```
